description: Commencement of tourism activities at the Nildiya Pokuna located in the Ravana Ella Sanctuary under the supervision and regulation of the Department of Wildlife Conservation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Nildiya Pokuna, located within an internal cave complex of the Ravana Ella Sanctuary in the Karandagolla Grama Niladhari Division of the Ella Divisional Secretariat in the Badulla District, is a very rare natural water source. The place has become a very popular tourist destination among local and foreign tourists due to its unique geographical features. Since the Nildiya Pokuna is a rare natural resource that needs to be preserved, it has been identified as an essential task to properly monitor and regulate tourism activities at the place. A Technical Committee representing university professors and relevant government institutions has been appointed to obtain suggestions and recommendations for this purpose, and the Committee has submitted a study Report. Based on the suggestions and recommendations included in the said Report, the regulations prepared to regulate tourism activities have been examined and confirmed by the Legal Draftsman. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to publish the relevant regulations in the Gazette in accordance with the provisions of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance, was approved by the Cabinet.
